SASBDB entry SASDK94  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDK94/)

Publication: BusR senses bipartite DNA binding motifs by a unique molecular ruler architecture.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkab736

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDK94/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
